alphas.name: event_option_volume_gate_baseline
alphas.notes: The baseline kept turnover low, but the aggregate IS line stayed clearly negative and never approached candidate quality.

alphas.name: event_option_volume_gate_fast_gate
alphas.notes: Speeding up the trigger window made the branch materially worse without unlocking a better return profile.

alphas.name: event_option_volume_gate_vol_rank
alphas.notes: Using pcr_vol_all for both the gate and the ranking leg was the least bad branch, but it was still negative and came with meaningfully higher turnover and drawdown.

alphas.name: event_option_volume_gate_smoothed_oi
alphas.notes: Smoothing the OI leg did not rescue the sign problem; it stayed broadly as weak as the fast-gate variant.

batch_observation.branch_takeaway: The confirmed option PCR lane is real on the account, but this first four-simulation family failed cleanly. All four branches produced negative aggregate IS Sharpe and Fitness, and the least bad variant still had no visible submission-check evidence and no non-null subuniverse verdict. The correct posture is kill this option-gate family and branch again rather than polish or submit.
